note: Closed motion vocabulary. Every pattern cites the clone source. reducedMotionFallback is PRESCRIPTIVE for generated pages: the clone itself never reads prefers-reduced-motion (sourceHonoursReducedMotion false everywhere; src has no reduced-motion rule).

static.description: No motion beyond hover colour and arrow nudges (0.3s ease).

reveal.fade-up.description: Scroll reveal: element fades in while rising 20px (30px for the fast variant), 0.65s ease, staggered by data delays, once, when 50% visible.

reveal.slide-in.description: Scroll reveal: element fades in while sliding 20px sideways (reverse flips direction), 0.65s.

page.fade.description: Whole page (main + footer) fades in 0.5s after a 0.5s delay on load and fades out 0.5s before an internal navigation.

marquee.loop.description: Endless linear horizontal loop of the logo strip (100s per cycle).

carousel.fade-autoplay.description: Cross-fading carousel: 300ms fade, advances every 3000ms (after each transition end), loops, touch swipe.

tabs.fade.description: Tab click fades the panel (300ms) and swaps the section colour instantly; no autoplay.

carousel.slide.description: Sliding carousel (850ms ease), manual arrows and swipe, optional autoplay (3500ms on the timeline).

timeline.loop.description: Desktop timeline: one milestone visible at a time, fading in 0.4s and out 0.6s after a 5s hold, repeating forever (skipped at 768px and below).

counter.count-up.description: Number counts from 0 to its value in 1.5s (power2.out) when its top crosses 88% of the viewport; plays once.

accordion.expand.description: Panel height or grid-rows expands in 0.3-0.4s with a plus/minus icon swap.

nav.dropdown.description: Click-to-open dropdown panel (no animation) and a 350ms grid-rows accordion for the mobile menu.

media.click-to-play.description: Thumbnail and play icon sit over an embedded player; a click removes them and starts autoplay.

logo.peel.description: Footer wordmark slides up out of a clipped box (0.75s ease) when revealed.

panel.slide-in.description: Off-canvas panel slides in from the right over a backdrop (0.85s cubic-bezier).

scroll.smooth.description: Page-wide smooth scrolling (Lenis, 1.2s exponential ease-out); hash links scroll with an 85px offset. Global behaviour, not a per-section pattern.
